message:
test(ci): fail readably on a --config flag that carries no path

The previous guard checked that the substring `--config` appeared in the
labeler step, then split on it and took the first token of the tail. A
workflow whose run block ends with a bare `--config` passes that check,
leaves an empty tail, and raises `IndexError: list index out of range` —
the same unreadable failure the guard was added to remove, one shape over.

It now checks the split produced a tail, then that the tail holds a token,
before indexing. A missing flag and a valueless flag each fail with a
message naming what is wrong.
